title: The Interpreter's Parley
logline: An unaligned dialect interpreter mediating a truce between two insular asteroid clans discovers their ancestral proverb accidentally insults the other clan if translated literally.

roles.description: A weary linguist specializing in archaic belt dialects; desperate to broker peace before fighting reaches their home station.
Patriarch of the ice-mining clan; rigid, proud, and listening for disrespect in every translated phrase.
Leader of the rock-hauler clan; suspicious of formal treaties and nursing a decade-old family grudge.
An unpressurized observation cupola mounted on a dead orbital buoy midway between clan territories.
A dusty document locker at an old trade mission station holding ancestral idiom ledgers.

public_situation: Two insular asteroid mining clans on {system} declare a temporary ceasefire to negotiate water drilling rights inside a neutral observation cupola.
private_truth: The ancestral treaty text hinges on an ancient shared idiom that means 'peaceful coexistence' in one dialect but 'subjugation of cattle' in the other if rendered verbatim.

beats.public_change: Mining clan skiffs power down thrusters around the neutral parley hub as armed sentries take position.

missions.reason: She hires an unaligned pilot to retrieve the century-old dialect lexicons from the trade mission locker before the first round of parley opens.
missions.private_fact: She suspects the clans' mutual hatred is rooted in an accidental linguistic misunderstanding from the colony's founding voyage.

beats.public_change: Heated shouting breaks out over open parley frequencies as both clans interpret preliminary translations as hostile insults.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to scan the parley station's communication relays to verify whether the rival clan's acoustic transmissions match the translated text.
missions.private_fact: He is looking for any pretext to abandon the talks and launch a preemptive assault against the rock-haulers' main refinery.

beats.public_change: Both clan leaders withdraw to their shuttles and prime docking clamps, preparing to break off the parley and open fire.

missions.reason: She begs the pilot to rush an emergency amended treaty docket to the parley airlock before the clan shuttles disconnect.
missions.private_fact: She deliberately smoothed over the insulting idiom with a diplomatic euphemism; if either side discovers her alteration, she faces banishment.

player_choice.prompt: With the parley hanging by a thread, the pilot can endorse the sanitized translation, expose the linguistic error openly, or allow the talks to fail.

options.label: Deliver the smoothed translation so both sides sign the fragile peace
Present the historical lexicons proving the insult was a century-old linguistic error
Withhold the treaty and let the rival clans settle the dispute with weapons

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the sanitized treaty docket, allowing both clans to sign.
resolutions.summary: Both clans sign the treaty under {role:clan_interpreter}'s smoothed phrasing. Mining resumes peacefully, though the fragile peace rests on a white lie.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot carried an amended treaty that stopped a blood feud between rival asteroid clans.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot presents the original lexicons proving the feud stemmed from an etymological misunderstanding.
resolutions.summary: Confronted by historical proof, {role:elder_clansman} and {role:rival_matriarch} realize their feud was born of a mistranslation. The clans agree to joint mining rights.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved a decades-long clan feud was caused by a mistranslated proverb.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot withholds the docket or never gets involved.
resolutions.summary: The parley breaks down in bitter accusations. Both clans undock their gunboats and retreat behind reinforced defensive perimeters, severing all trade in {system}.

loose_threads.detail: The lexicon shipping crates bear customs seals from a regional philanthropic trust that went bankrupt twenty years ago.
The communications relay at the parley station contains an active fiber tap linked directly to a commercial ore brokerage.

radio_hooks: Mining clan negotiations at neutral observation buoy enter critical phase in {system}.
Ice ore spot prices fluctuate as rival extraction cartels debate parley terms.
Belt trade delegates urge clan patriarchs to reach peaceful extraction accords.

voice_direction.clan_interpreter: Fast, analytical, and constantly parses grammar nuances. Becomes anxious and hesitant when explaining why certain words were omitted.
voice_direction.elder_clansman: Slow, rumbling, and speaks with archaic grammatical formality. Pauses heavily between sentences to weigh every syllable.
voice_direction.rival_matriarch: Sharp, direct, and impatient with academic terminology. Frequently cuts off pleasantries to demand concrete figures.
